The '''lake level''' was a five story facility located within the walls of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Used as a meditative retreat, the lake and beach area was a place of quiet contemplation and reflection.

==History==
Built within the Temple Ziggurat, this vast chamber was destroyed and rebuilt several times in the Temple's long history, seeing completion in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] under the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], a string of [[Incident at the Jedi Temple|robberies]] broke out in the Temple and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] assigned [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Tahl]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to lead the investigation. After Jinn's [[Jedi Temple dormitory|quarters]] had been violated, the blind Master Tahl was able to recognize the foreign scent in Jinn's room as the smell of the lake. Summoning the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]] to the lake, Jinn tasked her with searching the bottom of the massive pool for clues. Upon resurfacing, Eerin brought a chest with her, similar to the ones used on her homeworld, [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Opening the airtight compartment, Eerin revealed the items that had been stolen from the Temple, including the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of former Padawan [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="TUP" />

Jinn and Tahl returned to the lake soon after to set up a trap for the mysterious thief that was vandalizing the Temple. Due to heightened security measures, the lights in the lake level were powered off, allowing the two Masters to travel unseen throughout the chamber. Hoping to catch the thief upon their return to the lake. Jinn was about to capture a suspect when Tahl's Council-appointed navigation [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[2JTJ|TooJay]], appeared and alerted the intruder, causing them to flee. While the trap was foiled, Jinn managed to get a glimpse of the thief and recognize him as the Padawan [[Bruck Chun]].<ref name="TUP" />

Upon returning to the Temple, former Padawan Kenobi walked with Eerin around the lake, trying to think of a way to impress upon the Council his commitment to the Order and the sincerity behind his request to return to the Order. As they walked, the pair noticed that a horizontal [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] car was dangling precariously from a broken shaft. Acting quickly, Kenobi accessed the service stairway that would take him up into the room's illumination bank. Climbing gently into the shattered shaft, Kenobi assisted Master [[Ali-Alann]] in the removal of the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|youngling]] [[Unnamed clan (Jedi Temple)|clan]] he had been escorting to the nearest [[Jedi Temple refectory/Legends|dining hall]]. Meanwhile, Eerin had rushed to the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]], having found the turbolift control faulty, to notify the Council. The august body had rushed to the lake and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to hold the car steady while the younglings were escorted to safety. Upon their return to ground level, the Council thanked Eerin for her quick thinking, while they reprimanded Kenobi for acting alone. The Council deemed the lake level unsafe and closed it until repairs could be made.<ref name="TCT">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Captive Temple]]''</ref>

Soon after Jinn and Tahl discovered that [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Xanatos]] was behind the attacks, Eerin approached Jinn and told him about the tunnels running under the lake. Jinn, Kenobi, and Eerin entered the lake and dove deep into the water, accessing a hidden grate located in a boulder. Passing through the tunnel, they were deposited into the main water service tunnel that provided water to the fountains and reflecting pools in that wing of the Temple. After searching the tunnels, Jinn confronted Xanatos over the water purification units; after a brief duel, Xanatos slipped away, and Jinn and the Padawans retreated back to the lake.<ref name="TCT" />

Several decades later, at the end of the violent [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic, which the Jedi had served for so long, was dissolved and transformed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Temple was placed under martial law by decree of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. The [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], stormed the Temple and executed its occupants, damaging the Temple in the process. The Temple's lake level was laid to waste, the water turned off, leaving the plants to die and the water to grow clouded and tepid.<ref name="ROTS" />

The lake level would stand in silence for several more decades, slowly crumbling from disuse and lack of care. When [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and Vader were slain, the Empire lost balance and was eventually [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|driven]] from Coruscant by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Coruscant was devastated by [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]], causing the Temple to crumble and revealing parts of the foundation.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref> When the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] reclaimed the world, [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] ordered the [[Reconstruction Authority]] to [[New Jedi Temple|rebuild]] the ancient edifice as a gift for the great sacrifices made by the [[New Jedi Order|reformed Order]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. While the structure was rebuilt using blueprints of the old building, it is unknown if the lake level was reconstructed or replaced.<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

==Layout==
Located within the Jedi Temple, the lake level made up five stories of the massive structure. Upon entering, it was said the atmosphere of the chamber made one feel as if they were standing on the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The floor was covered with grass and flowering plants. Trees were strategically placed near benches or rocks. At the center of the chamber was an expansive lake, the clear green water of which lapped the beach area with its gentle rippling. In between classes, it wasn't unusual for the younger apprentices to come to the lake for a relaxing swim in the calm waters. Lined with the stones and sand, the bottom of the lake concealed portals into the Temple's massive water tunnels, which led away into the giant purification complex.<ref name="TUP" />

To continue the illusion of being outdoors, the ceiling of the lake level was covered in carefully placed lightbanks that created the illusion of the outside sky. Beyond the illusion were catwalks and service stairways used to accommodate the [[Temple employee]]s that maintained the light systems. Additionally, a horizontal turbolift ran above the lake, connecting the dormitories with a dining hall.<ref name="TUP" />
